g.title: BM4DetailedArchitecture
g.text: Current source ownership from potential to Solution. One nonlinear solve surrounds the complete twelve-stage palindromic composition.
Orange: method configuration. Green: spatial maps, projection and passive energy. Blue: lifecycle and shared records. Purple: opt-in observations.
N = particle count; m = 2N physical coordinates; q = 4N or 6N accepted internal coordinates; T = saved times. Module paths are repository-relative.

g.title: cluster_contracts
g.text: contracts/ | Shared input, step and output records

g.title: Potential
g.text: Grid; spatial mode amplitudes; time dependence.
evaluate(t, x, y, dx, dy, dt)
Interpolation and field derivatives live here.
Dynamics consumes the same physical field.

g.title: H5Loader
g.text: HDF5 field, magnetic field, characteristic length,
Normalize measured coordinates and field data.
Study parameters remain explicit at the caller.
Metadata describes the loaded physical source.

g.title: Dynamics
g.text: N planar particles; physical size m = 2N.
Uses the gyroaveraged potential at radius rho.
Both BM4 copies evaluate this same physical field.

g.title: GC
g.text: Field uses the gyroaveraged electric potential.

g.title: Grid
g.text: Periodic spatial axes; shape and spacing.
normalize(x, y): wrap coordinates into the cell.
Potential owns interpolation on this grid.
Physical periodicity is separate from the
integration time grid and output sample grid.

g.title: Capabilities
g.text: spatial map evaluations without analytic Jacobians.

g.title: Projection
g.text: mu in R^(2N); initial guess mu=0.
Return multiplier, SolveStats and converged trace.

g.title: Head_initial
g.text: Physical input and packed GC layout

g.title: Initial
g.text: set_initial_state validates and copies the vector.
Concrete geometry supplies the physical layout.
The caller combines this configuration and

g.title: InitialGC
g.text: Each component supplies N initial positions.
validates the initial state and physical dimensions.

g.title: Layouts
g.text: (u, v) = [ux, uy, vx, vy] in component-major blocks.
Each block contains all N particle values.
The source layout interprets saved trajectories.

g.title: Head_formulations
g.text: Doubled state and exact map order

g.title: Doubled
g.text: q = 4N, or 6N with passive time and kappa.
Accepted copies are diagonal; physical size m = 2N.
Time and kappa never enter the nonlinear root.

g.title: Maps
g.text: BM4 binds spatial maps without internal energy variables.
Exact harmonic mixing C_delta uses angle 2*w*delta.

g.title: Direct
g.text: Two shears at evaluation time tau
Direct stages evaluate at the signed stage endpoint.
Reuse for exact tangents and passive quadrature.

g.title: Adjoint
g.text: Adjoint stages evaluate at the signed stage start.
Two shears at evaluation time tau
No diagonal projection between the twelve stages.

g.title: StateFinish
g.text: finish embeds z_next into both accepted copies.
Append t+h and updated kappa when tracking.
Auxiliary values are separate diagnostic arrays.
Physical momentum kappa; generalized energy H+kappa.
The doubled momentum convention is k=2*kappa.

g.title: Composition
g.text: Sum c_i = 1; a4 < 0. Phi_h is the complete recipe.
delta_i = c_i*h; tau starts at t.
Adjoint uses tau; direct uses tau+delta_i; then advance tau.
Two field evaluations per stage; 24 per composition.
Every residual evaluation traverses the full recipe.
CompositionTrace retains all twelve accepted stages.

g.title: Head_methods
g.text: One reduced solve around twelve stages

g.title: Config
g.text: FD relative step = cube root of machine epsilon.
Constructor validates numerical and solver choices.

g.title: Initialize
g.text: Bind SolverOptions and the shared BM4 recipe.
One nonlinear solve per accepted main step.

g.title: Advance
g.text: No collection or observer dispatch inside advance.

g.title: EngineEntry
g.text: The projection encloses all twelve signed map stages.
Accepted CompositionTrace is reused by consumers.
See the six numerical cards below the source columns.
BM4Implicit always selects the reduced multiplier root.

g.title: Solver
g.text: Choose analytic particle blocks or centered differences.
Update by secants; no field Jacobian evaluation.
Retain the converged residual payload and tolerance.
Raise on non-convergence or invalid corrections.

g.title: NewRun
g.text: new_run copies constructor options to a fresh instance.
Bind problem and request; call initialize (3).
Copy and freeze initial_state and metadata.
Reuse options by creating another fresh run.

g.title: Coordinator
g.text: Validate interval and internal state; record statistics.
Dispatch optional event; save requested samples.
Check full time coverage; export physical history.
Merge metadata, work, auxiliary data and aliases.

g.title: Controller
g.text: Call advance once per main step.
Reuse accepted endpoints. For an interior time,
evaluate an independent shortened BM4 map.
Shadow maps do not alter the main trajectory,
accepted-step counters or observer event sequence.

g.title: Collector
g.text: Small per-step metric arrays with stable shapes.
Record accepted times and effective step sizes.
Event histories are retained only by observers.
Output-only sampling is separate from main-step work.

g.title: Export
g.text: Formulation extracts states [m, T] and auxiliaries.
Export does not repeat numerical projection.

g.title: Observation
g.text: stage_events copies the converged twelve-stage trace.
Physical before/after states; multiplier; solve statistics.
Stage states are spatial doubled values [4N].
Step map_state reruns the same physical projection.
Each stage map_state uses its stored signed time.
Callback evaluations are opt-in diagnostic work.

g.title: Tangents
g.text: Retained shear inputs avoid spatial replay.
Perturb the full doubled input in both directions.
Differentiate Phi_h; assemble a dense 2N system.
Extra map calls are not residual-evaluation counts.

g.title: Simulate
g.text: The inherited lifecycle starts in integration/ (2).
Stateless orchestration around the numerical run.
The same call resumes with IntegrationData (8).

g.title: Facade
g.text: Re-exports point to their canonical implementations.

g.title: Failure
g.text: Non-finite maps; singular solve; iteration limit.
Invalid accepted intervals or final output.
Integration finalization marks the run finished.
Numerical exceptions propagate to the caller.
A failed run does not produce a successful Solution.

g.title: Resume
g.text: Physical row count matches the initial state.
The first saved column equals the initial state.
Expose the validated physical Solution to the caller.

g.title: Solution
g.text: diagnostics: read-only mapping of copied values.
Own copies of trajectory and diagnostic arrays.
Numerical run resources are not retained.

g.title: Validation
g.text: Finite increasing times and finite state history.
Compatible time and state array dimensions.
Copy and freeze arrays; freeze diagnostic mapping.
Simulation separately checks agreement with inputs.

g.title: Diagnostics
g.text: states [2N,T]; t [T]. With energy: H, kappa and H+kappa
arrays follow these same T saved times.
One solve per main step; variable residual work.
Requested tolerances are not trajectory error bounds.

g.title: ResultUse
g.text: Compose reproducible runs and reference comparisons.
Interpret physical errors and method diagnostics.
Plots, summaries and animations consume results.
For time-dependent fields, compare physical H
with the reference history; H need not be conserved.

g.title: Energy
g.text: Sum over the 24 retained shear sources.
Evaluate energy only after spatial convergence.
Use the converged trace with signed stage durations.
No extra spatial composition is required.
It returns an increment; integration stores the output.

g.title: AcceptedTrace
g.text: The payload belongs to the converged residual evaluation.
Doubled input and output; twelve stages.
Each stage retains time, duration, map kind and shear inputs.
Analytic tangents, passive energy and public stage events.
Records become retained history only through an observer.

g.title: ProblemContract
g.text: Validate compatible physical dimensions and finite state.
Saved times include both requested interval endpoints.
The caller assembles physics and initial geometry.
The request owns temporal controls shared by all methods.

g.title: LayoutContract
g.text: initial_state and layout describe the packed physical input.
The concrete GC layout lives in initial_conditions/.

g.title: StepContract
g.text: Internal states are separate from physical observer snapshots.
The collector stores statistics, not numerical detail histories.

g.title: OutputContract
g.text: Returned by the numerical method to simulate.
Twelve base stages, multiplier and solve statistics.
Caller-owned observers retain copied events when requested.

g.title: MidpointVariant
g.text: Same spatial maps and time clock
compose starts at (z,z); z_next=(u+v)/2 after all twelve stages.
No multiplier equation or nonlinear solver. Diagnostic: copy_separation_norms.
coupling_frequency = pi/8, while BM4Implicit defaults to 0.0.
Both share DoubledFormulation, composition, maps and passive energy.
Use explicit matching options when comparing the methods.
Arithmetic averaging does not imply exact symplecticity or reversibility.
Observer type: IntegrationStep with physical states; no implicit BM4 solve event.

g.title: Reading
g.text: potential -> GC dynamics; dynamics + GC initial configuration -> InitialValueProblem; caller selects BM4Implicit + request.
(1) simulate -> (2) new_run -> (3) initialize -> (4) integrate_method -> (5) FixedStepController -> (6) advance.
reduced solve -> twelve-stage composition per residual -> converged physical result -> optional passive energy.
collect accepted steps and output samples -> (7) export IntegrationData -> (8) simulate resumes -> (9) Solution.
Solid: calls, dependencies or implementation relationships. Dotted blue: returns. Dashed purple: optional events or analysis. Red dashed: failure.
Arrows show selected relationships; card subtitles identify the implementation owner. BM4Midpoint is an alternative method, not a fallback.
